summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-printing feature in the rich repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base prefix "json.", one combined pattern for brace, literals, number, str). rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* theme keys. rich/json.py (new) adds the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or NullHighlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns text) and a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and a stderr "Unable to read" error with exit -1. rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print, importing JSON lazily. rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print, delegating to get_console(); __all__ unchanged. Tests added: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py (exact truecolor ANSI expectation, hand-derived and unverified) and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py. Docs: "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst before "Low level output", new docs/source/reference/json.rst linked from reference.rst, and a CHANGELOG Unreleased Added entry. Choices: overflow "none" implemented as Python None because Text.overflow has no "none" value; CLI imports Console inside the __main__ block; run as python -m rich.json FILE. Nothing committed; tests not run.
